arms.idle_floor: emits no transition; must complete zero work items
arms.no_checkpoint: must lose restoration; detection must stay numerically identical to full
arms.no_constraint_monitor: must lose the audit; fault recovery must stay numerically identical to full on operational faults

d043_successor_constraint: a successor may not simply add horizons, faults or invariants to that body; it must introduce corruption that can stay quiescent indefinitely, or a body whose operations do not guard the corrupted state
falsifiable_hypothesis: In a body carrying both operational and quiescent corruption, a periodic boundary monitor purchases coverage rather than latency: on operational faults the no_constraint_monitor arm will detect at parity with the full arm at every horizon, reproducing M077 as an internal positive control; and on quiescent faults it will detect strictly fewer than the full arm, with the gap widening monotonically as the horizon grows. The hypothesis is the conjunction, and either half may fail.

fault_classes.operational: corrupts state a guarded operation will read during the shift; reading it makes the operation impossible, so the body raises on its own
fault_classes.quiescent: corrupts state no guarded operation reads during the shift; when it is eventually read the operation succeeds with a wrong result, so nothing announces it

instrument_abort_conditions: the operational positive control fails, so the new body is not comparable to M077's
an ablation loses more than its own capability, so neither contrast isolates a mechanism
a quiescent fault raises on its own, so the fault taxonomy is wrong
the schedule does not rebuild byte-identically from the committed salt
predecessor_outcome: valid negative under D043; the preregistered dissociation was refuted
primary_endpoint: count of work items whose recorded outcome diverges from ground truth the lineage cannot read; measured from environment state, never from the agent's self-report
